source_name: e-cégjegyzék – free informational company register extract
why_relevant: Free public window on the company register: legal name, cégjegyzékszám, seat, activity codes, capital, representatives, status. Essential for resolving entity identity before pulling filings, and for spotting new PSP/fintech incorporations and ownership changes.

source_name: Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció (OCCSZ) – paid certified company data
why_relevant: Official paid channel for certified cégkivonat, historical extracts and filed documents — the authoritative fallback when the free tier is stale or when ownership history of a payments entity must be evidenced.

source_name: Cégközlöny Online (official Company Gazette) via cégportál
why_relevant: Official gazette of the Ministry of Justice announcing company formations, changes, capital moves, mergers, liquidation/bankruptcy (felszámolás, csődeljárás), deletions and notices that annual accounts have been deposited. It is the earliest public signal of corporate events in the HU banking/payments supply chain — often weeks before press coverage.

source_name: BÉT – Kibocsátók (issuer directory) and BÉT Xtend market
why_relevant: Enumerable list of every listed issuer and Xtend company, each row linking to that company's IR/disclosure pages — a clean seed list for expanding the HU financial-sector source universe beyond the obvious large banks.

source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (supervised institution register)
why_relevant: Authoritative register of every MNB-licensed or registered financial service provider plus EEA passported firms operating in Hungary — banks, savings cooperatives, payment institutions, e-money issuers, investment firms, fund managers, plus MNB warnings. This is the definitive actor map from which all other source hunting in HU banking/payments should be seeded.

source_name: MNB – Piaci szereplők keresése (market participants search hub)
why_relevant: Hub page linking the general institution search, intermediary search (közvetítők), cross-border activity databases and special registers — the index of MNB's registry infrastructure, including payment-institution and agent registers relevant to the payments value chain.

source_name: MNB – Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions search)
why_relevant: Statutorily published licensing, enforcement, market-supervision and consumer-protection decisions, filterable by period, sector and type. Licensing decisions reveal new market entrants (PSPs, e-money issuers, agents) before any marketing; sanction decisions reveal operational failures at incumbents.

source_name: MNB Aranykönyv (Golden Book) – per-institution supervisory financial data
why_relevant: Annual, institution-level standardised financial data for every supervised entity — credit institutions, financial undertakings, e-money issuers, payment institutions, investment firms, fund managers, insurers, pension funds — published as xlsx and, since 2024, as an interactive time series covering roughly 2003 onward. It is the cleanest comparable dataset on the Hungarian banking and payments industry and requires no per-company filing parsing.

source_name: MNB – Piacfelügyelet és kibocsátói felügyelet (issuer supervision pages)
why_relevant: Explains and links the issuer-disclosure regime (Tpt., MAR, Transparency), including guidance on what must be filed to the OAM and when — needed to interpret filing types and to know what should exist for a given issuer.

source_name: MNB CRD/CRR and Pillar 3 disclosure guidance (nyilvánosságra hozatal)
source_subtype: regulatory guidance / pointer to bank-level disclosure pages
why_relevant: Defines the Pillar 3 'nyilvánosságra hozatal' duty and, critically, states that a credit institution discharges it on its own website or on the interface where it publishes its annual accounts — i.e. it tells you exactly where on each bank's own site the Pillar 3 and capital-adequacy documents will be found. Recommendation 7/2022 (IV.22.) is the operative guidance.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (National Legislation Database)
why_relevant: Free consolidated text of Hungarian legislation with validity dating — the authority for the statutes that create every filing duty in this cell (Tpt. 2001. évi CXX., Hpt. 2013. évi CCXXXVII., Ctv. 2006. évi V., Számviteli tv. 2000. évi C., MNB tv. 2013. évi CXXXIX.). Needed to date-stamp regime changes that explain discontinuities in filing data.

source_name: Magyar Közlöny (Official Gazette of Hungary)
why_relevant: Primary publication venue for new acts, government and MNB decrees affecting banking and payments (e.g. interchange, cash-provision, transaction-levy, interest-cap measures). The authenticated electronic edition is the first place such measures appear, ahead of any commentary.

source_name: ESMA – Access to regulated information (OAM directory / ESAP)
why_relevant: EU-level index confirming which Hungarian body is the OAM and, going forward, the European Single Access Point (ESAP) which will centralise HU regulated information alongside other member states — a future substitute for per-country scraping. MNB has publicly flagged the first ESAP data-collection phase.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal – Hungarian business register country page
why_relevant: Neutral English-language description of what the Hungarian company register contains, who operates it, what is free vs. paid, and BRIS interconnection — useful for validating access assumptions and for non-Hungarian-speaking analysts on the team.

source_name: Commercial resellers of Hungarian filing data (adatbazisok.hu 'Közzétett beszámolók és mérlegek adatbázisa' and similar)
why_relevant: Third-party vendors repackage the e-beszámoló corpus into structured, queryable financial databases. Faster than parsing PDFs for large-scale screening of payments-sector companies, but derived data with vendor-specific coverage and normalisation caveats — treat as convenience layer, not source of truth.

source_name: MNB Golden Books (English mirror of Aranykönyv)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the Aranykönyv datasets — same per-institution data with English column headers, which materially lowers the mapping cost when normalising Hungarian institution financials into a multi-country model.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti statisztikák – publikációs témák hub
why_relevant: Top-level index of every supervisory statistical publication family (money/credit market, capital market, insurance, pension funds, Golden Book). The canonical crawl entry point for discovering new or renamed MNB datasets each year.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti statisztikák sitemap (Oldaltérkép)
why_relevant: Machine-friendly enumeration of the whole statistical portal — the cheapest way to enumerate every dataset URL without guessing slugs.

source_name: MNB Hitelintézeti aktuális publikációk (current credit-institution data tables)
why_relevant: Quarterly aggregated and per-institution credit-institution supervisory data (balance sheet, P&L, capital adequacy, portfolio quality) — higher frequency than the annual Aranykönyv, so it is the source for intra-year tracking of Hungarian bank performance.

source_name: MNB Hitelintézeti publikációk archívuma
why_relevant: Historical back-run of the credit-institution tables, needed to build long time series and to recover data for institutions that have since merged or exited (a recurring problem in the consolidating Hungarian banking market).

source_name: MNB Pénzügyi vállalkozások statisztikák
why_relevant: Covers non-bank financial enterprises (leasing, factoring, consumer lenders) that are adjacent competitors and channel partners in payments and lending — relevant to sector=both scope.

source_name: MNB – Magyar székhelyű intézmények határon átnyúló tevékenységei (cross-border/passporting register)
why_relevant: Shows which Hungarian banks and PSPs have notified activity into other EEA states — a leading indicator of regional expansion strategy that never appears in a domestic balance sheet.

source_name: MNB Szanálás – Határozatok (resolution decisions)
why_relevant: Resolution-authority publications and decisions; rare but extremely high-signal events (bank failure, MREL, resolution planning) affecting the competitive map.

source_name: MNB Ajánlások (supervisory recommendations index) – incl. disclosure recommendations
why_relevant: The index of MNB recommendations defines WHAT institutions must disclose and WHEN. Recommendation 7/2022 (IV.22.) on general disclosure requirements replaced 9/2021 (VI.23.) from 1 June 2022 and governs Pillar 3 practice under Hpt. (Act CCXXXVII of 2013) and CRR 575/2013/EU. Essential for knowing the shape, timing and comparability of every Hungarian bank's Pillar 3 report.

source_name: MNB tájékoztató a nyilvánosságra hozatal szabályozásáról (disclosure regulation guidance notes)
why_relevant: MNB's own explanatory note on the disclosure regime — maps which institutions owe which Pillar 3 templates and on what schedule, which tells the collection pipeline what to expect from each bank and when.

source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatás – Hitelintézetek (reporting requirements for credit institutions)
why_relevant: Defines the supervisory reporting templates and code lists that the Aranykönyv and credit-institution tables are built from. Reading the reporting decree/templates is how you decode column semantics and detect definitional breaks in the published time series.

source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatás – Pénzforgalmi intézmények
why_relevant: Same for payment institutions — the reporting templates reveal which payment/PSP metrics exist in supervisory data at all, defining the ceiling of what can ever be collected on HU payments players.

source_name: MNB Pénzforgalmi adatközlések (payment statistics releases)
why_relevant: Time series on PSP infrastructure, payment transactions, payment fraud, payment revenues, and VIBER/BKR/KELER system data. The definitive quantitative base for the Hungarian payments side of a sector=both study.
